title: Next Permutation
statement_md:
A **permutation** of an array of integers is an arrangement of its members into a sequence or linear order.

Given an array of integers `nums`, find the next lexicographical greater permutation of its numbers.

If such an arrangement is not possible, rearrange it as the lowest possible order (i.e., sorted in ascending order).

The replacement must be **in place** and use only constant extra memory.
hints: Find the first decreasing element from the right `nums[i] < nums[i+1]`.
Swap `nums[i]` with the next larger element from the right, then reverse the suffix from `i + 1`.
editorial_md: Single-pass scan from right finding pivot, swap, and suffix reversal.
